title: Affine formula for extended noise mass
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with at least two elements, let $\rho\in\bbr$, and let $x,y\in\Omega$. The uniform extended noise mass from $x$ to $y$ equals $\rho$ if $y=x$ and $0$ otherwise, plus the uniform mass $(1-\rho)/|\Omega|$.
